prompt: Summarize main facts in two or three sentences; non-LongBench source material.
teacher_precision: FP32 QK and softmax; mean over GQA query heads
training: Same CE classifier, normalization, seed, optimizer, 40 epochs, val-CE checkpoint selection, validation-only quantile grid as original pilot.
changes: Generated states and chat summary prompts replace sampled teacher-forced raw-text positions; pooled full and old-adaptive trajectories.
scope: Small six-document training pilot; Hotpot50 is a previously inspected regression test, never a training or calibration set.
